name: Barbarian audit: raid-wide passives reach party members natively (#1051, #1069, #3730, #3904)
contract: All four passives use SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65), which Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura/UnitAura::FillTargetMap already deliver to every party member on the same map; none needs a script. #1051 Ancestral Wisdom (803511) effect 0 carries SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT (333, BasePoints 1) which AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll resolves into both HandleModHitChance and HandleModSpellHitChance, raising m_modMeleeHitChance/m_modRangedHitChance and m_modSpellHitChance by 1; its effect 2 is an inert DBC row (aura 0, BasePoints 0) and is not asserted. #1069 Crystal Enhancements (707541) effect 0 carries SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE (22, BasePoints 389, DieSides 1) with MiscValue 1 = SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL, i.e. Armor, and EffectRealPointsPerLevel 25.0 with BaseLevel/SpellLevel 30; SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue scales BasePoints by (casterLevel - max(BaseLevel, SpellLevel)) * RealPointsPerLevel before the DieSides=1 rule adds a flat +1, so a level-80 caster resolves 389 + (80-30)*25 + 1 = 1640, not the raw DBC BasePoints; AuraEffect::HandleAuraModResistance applies that scaled amount via HandleStatModifier(UNIT_MOD_ARMOR, ...), read back by the armor metric. #3730 Ancestral Fury (804731) carries SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE (192, BasePoints 10); AuraEffect::HandleModMeleeRangedSpeedPct calls Unit::ApplyAttackTimePercentMod, dividing the melee swing timer by 1.10. #3904 Manhunter (300879) effect 0 carries SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290, BasePoints 3) via the raid aura, and effect 1 is a self-only SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS (168, BasePoints 10, MiscValue 64 = Humanoid creature-type mask), implemented in Unit::SpellDamageBonus/MeleeDamageBonus with no direct harness metric, so effect 1 is only asserted via aura_amount. AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct ignores MiscValue and calls UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras + UpdateAllSpellCritChances, raising both melee_crit_chance and spell_crit_chance by 3. As already established for #1308 (One With The Ancestors), PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE/PLAYER_SPELL_CRIT_PERCENTAGE1..7 are only ever recomputed from these AuraEffect handlers, so a character who has not yet had a crit-affecting aura applied or removed reads 0 rather than its true resting crit chance; the member here never received one before Manhunter (the earlier hit/armor/haste passives don't touch crit), so the scenario primes the member's crit fields with a throwaway learn+unlearn of Manhunter itself before taking the mcrit_m0/scrit_m0 baseline.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Put both Barbarians in one party
Baseline leader melee hit chance
Baseline member melee hit chance
Baseline member spell hit chance
Ancestral Wisdom reaches the leader
Ancestral Wisdom reaches the party member
Leader melee hit chance rises by 1
Member melee hit chance rises by 1
Member spell hit chance rises by 1
Unlearning removes it from the member too
Baseline member armor
Crystal Enhancements reaches the party member
Effect 0 resolves to 1640 armor (389 + (80-30)*25 level scaling + 1)
Member armor rises by 1640
Baseline member swing time
Ancestral Fury reaches the party member
Member swings are 10% faster (1/1.10 = 0.909)
Priming cycle: Manhunter applies to the member before baseline
Priming cycle: Manhunter is removed from the member again
Baseline member melee crit chance
Baseline member spell crit chance
Manhunter reaches the party member
Member melee crit chance rises by 3
Member spell crit chance rises by 3
Leader effect 1 (versus Humanoid) resolves to 10
